pr_title: Fixed a bug that caused erroneous updates of the playlist thumbnails
pr_body:
<!-- Hey there. Thank you so much for improving NewPipe, and filling out the details. Having roughly the same layout helps everyone considerably :)-->

#### What is it?
- [X] Bugfix (user facing)
- [ ] Feature (user facing)
- [ ] Codebase improvement (dev facing)
- [ ] Meta improvement to the project (dev facing)

#### Description of the changes in your PR
<!-- While bullet points are the norm in this section, feel free to write free-form text instead of a list -->
This is an attempt to fix the bug mentioned in #9458.
Currently, NewPipe stores the `thumbnailUrl` in the database. I deleted this field and replaced it with the `thumbnailStreamId` field, which stores the stream ID of the stream the thumbnail is from.
Since the `thumbnailUrl` is deeply rooted in the program, I had to make significant changes and perform a database migration to fix this problem. 

This PR makes it so that the thumbnail of a playlist is not just a url to an image, but rather is a reference to a stream in the database (which in turn contains a url to an image). This fixes the mentioned bug (since there aren't outdated thumbnails anymore), but also adds the nice feature of the playlist thumbnail getting updated automatically whenever the video's thumbnail changes.

#### Fixes the following issue(s)
<!-- Prefix issues with "Fixes" so that GitHub closes them when the PR is merged (note that each "Fixes #" should be in its own item). Also add any other relevant links. -->
- Fixes #9458 

#### APK testing

<!-- Remove the following line if you directly link the APK created by the CI pipeline. Directly linking is preferred if you need to let users test.-->
The APK can be found by going to the "Checks" tab below the title. On the left pane, click on "CI", scroll down to "artifacts" and click "app" to download the zip file which contains the debug APK of this PR.

#### Due diligence
- [X] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).

issue_context.title: Playlist thumbnail doesn't get updated after the "Remove Watched" dialog is used
issue_context.body:
### Checklist

- [X] I am able to reproduce the bug with the [latest version](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/releases/latest).
- [X] I made sure that there are *no existing issues* - [open](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/issues) or [closed](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed) - which I could contribute my information to.
- [X] I have read the [FAQ](https://newpipe.net/FAQ/) and my problem isn't listed.
- [X] I have taken the time to fill in all the required details. I understand that the bug report will be dismissed otherwise.
- [X] This issue contains only one bug.
- [X] I have read and understood the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/dev/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).

### Affected version

0.24.1

### Steps to reproduce the bug

1. Create a new playlist with two videos
2. Go to playlist overview
3. Go to the newly created playlist
4. Click "Background"
5. Listen for a couple of seconds
6. Click "Removed Watched"
7. Click "Yes, and partially watched videos"
8. Go to Playlist Overview

### Expected behavior

The thumbnail of the playlist should have changed to the only item in the playlist. 

### Actual behavior

The thumbnail doesn't get updated.



### Screenshots/Screen recordings

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26669009/203877279-809cfc90-4c17-4635-b995-1dde58416bce.mp4

### Logs

_No response_

### Affected Android/Custom ROM version

Android 12

### Affected device model

Pixel 5

### Additional information

I am a developer and plan to work on this problem myself.
comments:
How would you handle this if you manually set a Playlist thumbnail and the video that was used is removed later down the road?

I was searching for a video that fit the watch later Playlist and after I set the thumbnail I removed it again
Otherwise every Playlist would constantly switch to new thumbnails all the time

I can certainly understand your use case. However, if the playlist thumbnail doesn't change when you remove the video, it's considered a "bug" right now because NewPipe tries to update it but fails due to the problem I mentioned in my PR request.
Maybe we should introduce a permanent thumbnail selection feature, or disable updating a playlist thumbnail if you set it directly. Maybe your problem would be worth opening another feature issue?

> Maybe we should introduce a permanent thumbnail selection feature, or disable updating a playlist thumbnail if you set it directly. Maybe your problem would be worth opening another feature issue?

I always assumed it was be feature instead of a bug 🤔
Keeping thr thumbnail when it was set manually sounds reasonable to me. At least better than adding another option to the menu. 
The question is how it would be handled if the user wants to "unset" the permanent thumbnail once it has been set

I have just had another look and have found an interesting option. When you press on the three dots in the playlist there could be an option to permanently lock the thumbnail. If it is pressed, the thumbnail of the playlist won't change. If you then press "unlock thumbnail" it can be changed again and if the video is not in the playlist anymore the first video gets selected as the new thumbnail video. How do you like this idea?

> How do you like this idea?

Sounds like a good compromise to me 
Up to the devs if they want to add another setting for this edge usecase 

Might be useful for those who want to give their Playlist somewhat of an identity to distinguish between them. 

I'm not gonna shed any tears if the bug is fixed without a replacement for my use case but of course it would be nice to have a was to theme your Playlist page a bit

@AlertSubject I opened a feature request. #9468
If you have anything to add there, feel free to leave a comment.

review_comments: The reason for this change is addressed in [this comment](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/pull/9755#discussion_r1102103768).
Shouldn't `thumbnail_stream_id` be a foreign key to the streams table?
The `thumbnail_stream_id` can be `-1` to indicate a default thumbnail and not always reference a stream. Therefore, IMO it isn't necessary to use it as a foreign key to the streams table.
